fields.course_overview: Interpersonal and communication skills are essential for success in both professional and personal life. This program is designed for individuals, team leaders, and managers who want to enhance their ability to communicate effectively, collaborate with others, and minimize conflict in the workplace. The course helps participants identify and adapt their communication styles, improve listening and comprehension, and express themselves clearly and assertively. Through practical exercises and interactive sessions, delegates learn to build better relationships, handle difficult conversations, and maintain harmony in diverse situations.
fields.learning_outcomes:
By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

  • Apply different communication styles based on the situation
  • Express ideas assertively, confidently, and precisely
  • Ask effective questions to gather meaningful information
  • Recognize how others perceive them and adapt accordingly
  • Avoid misunderstandings and overcome communication barriers
  • Use empathy to build trust and communicate effectively
  • Deliver difficult messages while maintaining positive relationships
  • Interpret body language and non-verbal cues during communication
fields.course_content:
In this practical course, delegates will develop the skills to communicate with clarity, empathy, and confidence through the following key topics:

Communication Fundamentals

  • Methods and channels of communication
  • Common communication pitfalls and how to avoid them
  • Achieving clarity and effectiveness in every interaction

Listening and Understanding

  • Techniques for active and empathetic listening
  • Understanding the message behind the words
  • Overcoming barriers to effective communication

Interpersonal Dynamics

  • Building and maintaining positive relationships
  • Communicating across different personality types
  • Dealing with people under stress or pressure

Assertiveness and Influence

  • Expressing yourself confidently and respectfully
  • Developing assertiveness in challenging situations
  • Influencing others through credibility and empathy

Conflict Management

  • Identifying and addressing sources of conflict early
  • Managing difficult people and tense conversations
  • Turning potential conflict into constructive dialogue

Body Language and Non-Verbal Cues

  • Understanding how body language affects communication
  • Using gestures and tone to reinforce your message
  • Reading and interpreting non-verbal signals accurately

Core Principles of Communication

  • Communication is Inescapable: Even silence communicates meaning; our behavior always sends a message.
  • Communication is More Than Words: Tone, facial expressions, and body language often convey more than spoken words.
  • Communication is Irreversible: Once spoken, words cannot be taken back; their impact endures.
fields.who_needs_this_course:
This course is recommended for:

  • Professionals seeking to improve their communication and interpersonal effectiveness
  • Team leaders and supervisors who manage people or work in cross-functional teams
  • Managers aiming to foster better collaboration and resolve conflicts within their teams
  • Individuals who wish to build confidence in expressing themselves in various situations
fields.course_material: Participants receive detailed notes and handouts. Additional reference books and online resources are suggested for those who wish to explore the subject further.
fields.certification: A Course Completion Certificate will be awarded at the end of the training by ITTI.
